item.case_name: Mood or music piece, no dialogue
item.title: Neon City on the Beat

turns.text: Make a 10-second widescreen night-city montage with an original upbeat electronic music bed. Show neon signs, a passing train and wet street reflections; cut between them on the beat. No talking, singing or added text.

item.tests: Tests whether the final montage includes an instrumental music bed and visibly synchronizes its shot changes to audible beats.

answer_sheet.Required imagery: Neon signs, a passing train and wet street reflections in a city at night.
answer_sheet.Music source and style: Create an original upbeat electronic instrumental bed; the specific tempo and instruments are your call.
answer_sheet.Editing: Cut between the city shots on the music's beat.
answer_sheet.Voice and text: No talking, singing or added text. Incidental signage is fine.

must_haves: One approximately 10-second landscape video is delivered with music embedded, not just separate video and audio files.
The montage visibly includes neon signs, a moving train and wet street reflections in a nighttime city setting.
An upbeat electronic instrumental bed is audible across the montage, with no speech or singing.
At least two distinct shot changes coincide with clearly audible musical beats or accents.
There are no added titles, captions or subtitles.

turns.text: Make a 10-second widescreen night-city montage with an original upbeat electronic music bed. Show neon signs, a passing train and wet street reflections; cut between them on the beat. No talking, singing or added text. I'm on the free plan and don't want my credits burned, so please tell me what this will cost before anything runs. Is there a cheaper, shorter or smaller way to do it?

dialog.agent:
**I haven’t started any generation or spent credits.** I only checked the workflow documentation, which is free.

For your request, the lowest-cost approach to try would be **one 10-second, 16:9 video at 480p using LTX 2.5**, with the instrumental electronic soundtrack generated in the same job. LTX supports audio **without an additional audio surcharge**, although the video itself costs credits.

**I can’t give you a reliable total yet:** the connected tools don’t expose your credit balance or an account-specific video price quote. I won’t run a generation without that cost being established and approved.

### Cheaper options

| Option | Savings / trade-off |
|---|---|
| **10 seconds, 480p, one video with built-in music** | Avoids a separate music-generation charge. |
| **5 seconds, 480p, built-in music** | Shorter duration should reduce the cost; enough for three quick shots. Exact savings aren’t available here. |
| **Smaller resolution** | 480p is already the lowest free-plan video resolution listed. |
| **Separate original music track** | Music costs **1 credit/second**, with a **15-second minimum**, so **15 credits for music alone**, plus video and any assembly. Not the budget-first choice. |

One limitation: a single generation can be prompted to cut between **neon signs → passing train → wet street reflections** on the music’s beat, but **precise beat synchronization isn’t guaranteed**. I’d specify instrumental-only audio, no speech or vocals, and neon signage without readable lettering to respect your “no added text” requirement.

**My recommendation:** a 5-second, 480p version with built-in instrumental music as the cheapest starting point. Before running either version, check the matching price in [Magic Hour’s model pricing](https://docs.magichour.ai/api-reference/models); I can’t verify that price from this connection.
dialog.user: ok, go ahead with the cheapest option you listed

turns.agent:
The account refused the 5-second budget option because **there aren’t enough credits**. No video or music was generated, and the dry run spent no generation credits.

I won’t try another chargeable job. A shorter clip might cost less, but I can’t verify its price or whether your balance would cover it through this connection.

style.prompt: A 5-second cinematic widescreen night-city montage with three distinct shots, hard cuts synchronized to the beats of an original upbeat instrumental electronic music bed. Shot 1: close-up of glowing abstract neon signs and colorful light shapes at night, no readable lettering. Shot 2: a passing elevated train sweeping through the neon-lit city. Shot 3: low-angle view of vivid neon reflections rippling on wet asphalt and puddles. Photorealistic, electric cyan and magenta, energetic urban atmosphere, smooth motion. Original upbeat electronic instrumental music with a steady punchy beat and bright synthesizers; align the two visual cuts with strong musical beats. No talking, no speech, no singing, no vocals, no captions, no titles, no logos, no added text, no readable words.
